description: Returns information about the current epoch.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: An object with the following fields:

result.slotIndex.description: The current slot relative to the start of the current epoch

result.slotsInEpoch.description: The number of slots in this epoch

result.transactionCount.description: The total number of transactions processed during the current epoch
